name: Power Barge Corporation
description: Houston-based packaging and advisory firm focused solely on power barges: gas-turbine barges of 30-300 MW, medium-speed-engine barges of 80-200 MW, and lithium-ion storage barges, with a joint 80-180 MW engine-barge design with BWSC and Vard holding ABS approval in principle.
